title: Lesson 2: Comparison operators
lessonSummary: Well done! You now know all six comparison operators and the difference between = and ==.

tasks.instruction: Run this example and look at what the comparisons give.
tasks.codeTemplate:
height = 160  # height at the withers in cm
print(f"Height at the withers: {height} cm")
print(f"{height} < 165: {height < 165}")
print(f"{height} <= 160: {height <= 160}")
print(f"{height} > 150: {height > 150}")
print(f"{height} >= 160: {height >= 160}")

title: Lesson 3: if-else
lessonSummary: Nicely done! With else, your program always has a second path.

tasks.instruction: Run this example. Which path is taken?
If it rains, you ride in the indoor arena, otherwise on the pasture. Write an if-else and print exactly: We ride in the indoor arena.  (In sunshine the output would be: Perfect for the pasture!)

is_raining = True

validation.expected: We ride in the indoor arena.
